title: Lord of the Sabbath and Jesus' Exhortations

questions.question: What did the disciples do on the Sabbath as they went through the grainfields that angered the Pharisees?
options: They were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat
They built a fire to cook their food
They walked more than a Sabbath day's journey
They harvested an entire field
questions.correctAnswer: They were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat
questions.explanation: Matthew 12:1 (ESV): "At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry, and they began to pluck heads of grain and to eat."

questions.question: When the Pharisees confronted Jesus about this, what Old Testament ruler did Jesus mention who entered the house of God and ate the bread of the Presence?
options: David
Solomon
Hezekiah
Josiah
questions.explanation: Matthew 12:3-4 (ESV): "He said to them, 'Have you not read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him: how he entered the house of God and ate the bread of the Presence...'"

questions.question: What title does Jesus claim for Himself signifying His authority over the Sabbath?
options: "For the Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath."
"For the Son of Man is the master builder."
"For I am greater than Moses."
"For my Father owns the day."
questions.correctAnswer: "For the Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath."
questions.explanation: Matthew 12:8 (ESV): "For the Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath."

questions.question: In the synagogue, Jesus healed a man with a withered hand on the Sabbath after asking an allegorical question about rescuing what animal?
options: A sheep fallen into a pit
An ox stuck in the mud
A lost camel
A dove caught in a net
questions.correctAnswer: A sheep fallen into a pit
questions.explanation: Matthew 12:11 (ESV): "He said to them, 'Which one of you who has a sheep, if it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will not take hold of it and lift it out?'"

questions.question: After Jesus healed the man with the withered hand, what did the Pharisees go out and do?
options: They went out and conspired against him, how to destroy him
They went out and repented of their hardness of heart
They went straight to the Roman governor to complain
They dispersed quietly in fear
questions.correctAnswer: They went out and conspired against him, how to destroy him
questions.explanation: Matthew 12:14 (ESV): "But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how to destroy him."

questions.question: A prophecy of Isaiah is quoted about Jesus as God's servant: "a bruised reed he will not break, and a smoldering wick he will not..." what?
options: Quench
Ignite
Snuff out
Trim
questions.explanation: Matthew 12:20 (ESV): "a bruised reed he will not break, and a smoldering wick he will not quench..." (quoting Isaiah 42).

questions.question: When Jesus healed a demon-oppressed man who was blind and mute, who did the Pharisees claim was giving Jesus His power?
options: Beelzebul, the prince of demons
Satan, disguised as an angel of light
He was using Egyptian magic
He claimed power from the Emperor
questions.explanation: Matthew 12:24 (ESV): "But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, 'It is only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, that this man casts out demons.'"

questions.question: How did Jesus respond to the accusation that a demon was giving him power?
options: "Every kingdom divided against itself is laid waste, and no city or house divided against itself will stand."
"He who accuses me condemns himself."
"A house built on rock will withstand the storm."
"Do you question the Son of Man?"
questions.correctAnswer: "Every kingdom divided against itself is laid waste, and no city or house divided against itself will stand."
questions.explanation: Matthew 12:25 (ESV): "Knowing their thoughts, he said to them, 'Every kingdom divided against itself is laid waste, and no city or house divided against itself will stand.'"

questions.question: Jesus states that whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever speaks against whom will never be forgiven?
options: The Holy Spirit
God the Father
The Law of Moses
The Prophets
questions.explanation: Matthew 12:32 (ESV): "And whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the age to come."

questions.question: Out of what does the mouth speak, according to Jesus describing bad trees and good trees?
options: "For out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks."
"For out of the wisdom of the mind the mouth speaks."
"For out of the evil of the flesh the mouth speaks."
"For out of listening to false prophets the mouth speaks."
questions.correctAnswer: "For out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks."
questions.explanation: Matthew 12:34 (ESV): "You brood of vipers! How can you speak good, when you are evil? For out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks."

questions.question: Jesus said that on the day of judgment, people will give account for every what?
options: Careless word they speak
Sin committed in secret
Lie they told their neighbors
Coin they stole
questions.explanation: Matthew 12:36 (ESV): "I tell you, on the day of judgment people will give account for every careless word they speak,"

questions.question: When the scribes and Pharisees asked for a sign, what was the ONLY sign Jesus said would be given to this evil and adulterous generation?
options: The sign of the prophet Jonah
The falling of the stars from heaven
The sign of Moses in the wilderness
A voice from heaven like thunder
questions.correctAnswer: The sign of the prophet Jonah
questions.explanation: Matthew 12:39 (ESV): "But he answered them, 'An evil and adulterous generation seeks for a sign, but no sign will be given to it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.'"

questions.question: Who will rise up at the judgment and condemn this generation because they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and "behold, something greater than Jonah is here"?
options: The men of Nineveh
The queen of the South (Sheba)
The men of Sodom
The giants of ancient times
questions.explanation: Matthew 12:41 (ESV): "The men of Nineveh will rise up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and behold, something greater than Jonah is here."

questions.question: When an unclean spirit goes out of a person, passes through waterless places, and returns to find the house empty and swept, what does it do?
options: It goes and brings with it seven other spirits more evil than itself
It waits outside until the person falters again
It is cast immediately into the abyss
It finds a herd of swine instead
questions.correctAnswer: It goes and brings with it seven other spirits more evil than itself
questions.explanation: Matthew 12:45 (ESV): "Then it goes and brings with it seven other spirits more evil than itself, and they enter and dwell there, and the last state of that person is worse than the first."

questions.question: While Jesus was speaking, His mother and brothers sought to speak to Him. According to Jesus, who is His brother and sister and mother?
options: Whoever does the will of my Father in heaven
Anyone who believes in me
The twelve apostles selected before the crowd
Only Mary and those born in her house
questions.correctAnswer: Whoever does the will of my Father in heaven
questions.explanation: Matthew 12:50 (ESV): "For whoever does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother and sister and mother."

key_verse_text: "For whoever does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother and sister and mother."
